1.name: Monday: Push (Chest/Shoulders/Triceps)
1.cardio: Treadmill: 20 min | 5% incl. | 4.2 - 4.8 km/h (2.6 - 3.0 mph) [Alts: Stair Climber Lvl 5-6 | Elliptical Res 6-7]

exercises.name: Flat Bench Press: 3x6-8
exercises.detail: Mandatory scapular retraction. Lower bar to lower chest level.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press: 3x8-10
exercises.detail: Bench set to 30-45 degrees. Deep stretch on upper chest.

exercises.name: Seated Military Press: 3x8-10
exercises.detail: Core tight, do not arch lower back. Full range of motion.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises: 3x12-15
exercises.detail: Lead with elbows slightly bent. Controlled tempo on descent.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown: 3x10-12
exercises.detail: Elbows pinned to ribs. Squeeze peak contraction for 1 sec.

2.name: Tuesday: Legs 1 (Quad Focus) + Abs
2.cardio: Treadmill: 20 min | 0% incl. | 4.0 km/h (2.5 mph) [Alts: Stair Climber Lvl 4 | Elliptical Res 5]

exercises.name: Barbell Squat or Hack Squat: 3x6-8
exercises.detail: Break parallel depth. Push firmly through full foot plant.

exercises.name: Leg Press: 3x10-12
exercises.detail: Feet low on platform. Do not lock knees at full extension.

exercises.name: Leg Extension: 3x12-15
exercises.detail: Controlled concentric, 1-second hold at peak contraction.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl: 3x10-12
exercises.detail: Hips glued to bench. 3-second controlled eccentric phase.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises: 4x10-15
exercises.detail: Full stretch at bottom step, squeeze calves hard at top.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Crunch (Abs): 3x12-15
exercises.detail: Anchor feet securely on the decline board. Flex the spine (roll the torso), do not just hinge at the hips. Hold a weight plate across the chest if bodyweight is too
